name: The Brass Ring
english_description: A Dead Souls 3.8.x-based game-in-development (self-titled 'The Brass Ring') whose GitHub repo ships as a pure CONTENT OVERLAY, not a full mudlib -- its own README/Setup.txt say to download Dead Souls separately and drop these files onto it, and confirming this, the repo's secure/daemon/master.lpc (the whole security-daemon engine layer) was never committed to git history at all, not even gitignored. This port reconstructed the missing engine by rsyncing ds386's (Dead Souls 3.8.6) own pristine raw archive onto the overlay wherever TheBrassRing didn't ship a file of its own (--ignore-existing, verified byte-for-byte non-destructive to TBR's real content), then swapping every one of the resulting 4,676 gap-filled files for ds386's own ALREADY driver-compat-fixed work/ copy of the same path -- reusing every hand-fix ds386's own onboarding discovered rather than rediscovering them, the same precedent dshakkard (185) and AGENTS.md section 1.5 already established for this exact situation. On top of the reused ds386 engine, TBR bundles a full DikuMud Alfa port (domains/diku-alfa/, 1185 files -- Midgaard and its zones) and is actively building its own bespoke fantasy continent, Etnar (the village of Wyr, with NPCs Albert Derby/Waltin Kelley/Caltan Dowini/the Pierce family already in place and a virtual wilderness room system). Found and fixed real programming bugs in TBR's own code and the bundled diku-alfa content: a pervasive 'TYPE array NAME' old-MudOS dialect (this driver build lexes 'array' as a plain identifier, not a keyword, since it wasn't compiled with ARRAY_RESERVED_WORD) across 37 files/~120 sites including two sub-variants (a redundant 'TYPE array *NAME' double-star, and 'class TYPENAME array NAME'); this cascaded into 1873/3800 files (49%) failing a full lpcc_check.sh sweep until fixed, since it hit lib/body.lpc and lib/player.lpc, which nearly everything inherits. lib/player.lpc separately carried an un-starred 'string oldparties' bug already documented byte-identically in ds386's own raw archive by dshakkard's prior session. Also fixed: a missing closing brace silently dropping a whole function in etnar's own pierce_pascal.lpc NPC; a SertClass()/SetClass() typo and a SetMealType(string) vs SetMealType(int) argument-type bug in the bundled diku-alfa content; and 16 '#define __DIR__' collisions in etnar's and diku-alfa's virtual-room servers (same class dshakkard already catalogued, colliding with this driver's own native __DIR__ predefine). Left as pre-existing, non-driver-compat gaps matching classes ds386/dshakkard's own sweeps already documented: a genuinely truncated diku-alfa room file (confirmed byte-identical to the same file in the separate LashMUD/DikuMud-to-Dead-Souls-Port repo, i.e. an authentic upstream content gap, not conversion fallout), obj/stargate.lpc's deliberate anti-load trap, the missing opcprof() efun, and two builder scratch/template files. lpcc_check.sh full-corpus batch sweeps hit this driver's normal 'batch mode never unloads' memory ceiling on this unusually large corpus (3800 files) before completing a full pass (killed by this session's 8-9.5GB RSS safety net per AGENTS.md section 10.4's mega-lib memory-balloon guidance); the largest completed sample covered 2590/3800 files (68%) at a 99.2% pass rate with zero unexplained failures after the fixes above landed, so per section 10.4's own guidance the live boot+playthrough (not the partial sweep) is the authoritative verification here. Admin (fluffos/Mud@2026) was seeded via the standard Dead Souls file-move convention (secure/save/players -> secure/save/creators after a normal registration) -- TBR's own shipped secure/cfg/groups.cfg already lists fluffos in every ACL group, confirmed byte-identical to ds386's own stock placeholder groups.cfg, so no ACL edit was needed. Booted clean and verified live end-to-end with two independent new characters and a reconnect: full registration (age gate, screen-reader question, password, gender, email, an 8-race pick, and a complete 6/4/4 primary/secondary/minor skill selection across all 28 skills), 'enter town' correctly reaching Saquivor's real starting town (distinct from the tutorial start room), goto-verified Etnar (The Lounge, in Wyr) and diku-alfa (the Temple of Midgaard) content both rendering correctly, look/score/update(admin)/quit all correct, and reconnect restoring the same character/room/inventory. No outbound network connections at boot (DISABLE_IMC2 confirmed to actually gate imc2.lpc's socket calls, not just cosmetic; the Intermud daemon makes no socket calls of its own in this codebase) -- unlike several sibling Dead-Souls-family libs, this one is safe for high-frequency automated re-boot loops.
